CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS book_quote_staging (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    title VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,
    author VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
    quote TEXT NOT NULL,
    category VARCHAR(100),
    batch_index INTEGER,
    batch_size INTEGER,
    raw_emotions TEXT[],
    emotion_labels TEXT[],
    embedding vector(768),
    status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'collected',
    needs_review BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    retry_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    error_reason TEXT,
    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW(),
    processed_at TIMESTAMP,
    UNIQUE(title, author)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_book_quote_staging_status
ON book_quote_staging (status, created_at);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_book_quote_staging_category
ON book_quote_staging (category);

SELECT id, title, author, quote, category
FROM book_quote_staging
WHERE status = 'collected'
ORDER BY id
LIMIT 20;

INSERT INTO books (title, author, quote, category, emotion_labels, embedding)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.title.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.author.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.quote.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.category || 'unknown').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  ARRAY[{{ $json.emotion_labels.map(e => "'" + e.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'").join(',') }}]::TEXT[],
  '{{ $json.embedding }}'::vector
)
ON CONFLICT (title, author) DO UPDATE SET
  quote = EXCLUDED.quote,
  category = EXCLUDED.category,
  emotion_labels = EXCLUDED.emotion_labels,
  embedding = EXCLUDED.embedding;

UPDATE book_quote_staging
SET raw_emotions = ARRAY[{{ $('임베딩 파싱').item.json.raw_emotions.map(e => "'" + e.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'").join(',') }}]::TEXT[],
    emotion_labels = ARRAY[{{ $('임베딩 파싱').item.json.emotion_labels.map(e => "'" + e.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'").join(',') }}]::TEXT[],
    embedding = '{{ $('임베딩 파싱').item.json.embedding }}'::vector,
    needs_review = {{ $('임베딩 파싱').item.json.needs_review ? 'TRUE' : 'FALSE' }},
    status = '{{ $('임베딩 파싱').item.json.needs_review ? 'review_pending' : 'done' }}',
    processed_at = NOW(),

WHERE id = {{ $('임베딩 파싱').item.json.id }};
